issues.problem: addr value 前の列の人 is an awkward form of address next to the other 〜の皆さん values when announcing to a group.
issues.action: Replaced with 前[まえ]の列[れつ]の皆[みな]さん (English 'Front row' unchanged).

issues.problem: Distractor ことにしてください is not plainly wrong: 'なるべく早く寝ることにしてください' reads naturally as 'make it a rule to go to bed as early as possible', close to the English.
issues.action: Replaced with ようになりました, which clashes with なるべく plus a request and with the English 'please'.

issues.problem: With the item marked by は (粉薬は飲み…, ボタンは押し…, 靴は歩き…), distractor すぎて gives a grammatical object-topic reading ('took too much of the powder', 'pressed the buttons too much'), so it was not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Changed は to が in all eight item values (粉薬が飲みにくくて etc.). This is also the more natural marking for a cause clause and rules out the すぎて reading.
